# Interfaith Sanctuary

> Interfaith Sanctuary is a non-denominational gathering place — not a doctrine.
> It holds space for every religious tradition (and for people still searching)
> around seven shared principles inspired by the Noahide ethic, plus a shared
> commitment to the Golden Rule that nearly every tradition already recognizes.

## About

- Mission: create common ground between traditions by meeting as human beings first, without asking anyone to trade their own faith or vocabulary.
- The Seven Principles: Honor the Sacred; Speak with Reverence; Protect Life; Honor Loving, Respectful Relationships; Practice Generosity; Treat All Living Beings with Kindness; Build a Just and Fair Society.
- Community norms ("Ground Rules"): No Gurus; No Trolling/Ghosting/Silent Treatment; the space is held and led by women.
- Languages: English source text, with on-page translation via the Google Translate widget (includes right-to-left languages such as Hebrew and Arabic).
- Contact: guestbook form (routed through Formspree) and interfaith-sanctuary@protonmail.com; community gathers via a WhatsApp circle.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://interfaith-sanctuary.org/): who we are, the seven principles, the Golden Rule across traditions, ground rules, a reading list on "the shadow", and the guestbook.

## Related initiatives

Interfaith Sanctuary is one of six independent sibling nonprofit sites:

- [get-out-now.org](https://get-out-now.org/) — diaspora relocation / Law of Return guidance.
- [thelastdate.org](https://thelastdate.org/) — nonprofit matchmaking initiative.
- [projectshreeram.org](https://projectshreeram.org/) — Hindu–Jewish and India–Israel relations.
- [1in56million.org](https://1in56million.org/) — British-Israelite / genealogy research.
- [crypto-jews.org](https://crypto-jews.org/) — Anusim / Converso community and Sephardic genealogy.
